feeds.title: Outdoor Canada » Hunting
feeds.description: Canada's only national magazine for anglers & hunters, OutdoorCanada has been the exclusive source for all things fishing, hunting and conservation since 1972.

feeds.title: Ontario OUT of DOORS » Hunting
feeds.description: Ontario's anglers and hunters will find the best where-to, how-to, and new product information in each issue of Ontario OUT OF DOORS. Expertly written and featuring outstanding photography. Canada's best read outdoors magazine delivers fishing and hunting content that informs, inspires, and entertains readers.

feeds.title: The Hunting Gear Guy
feeds.description: The Hunting Gear Guy is a website with reviews on various hunting equipment and gear focused on the Canadian outdoors. I started this site because I find a lot of reviews out there lacking. They'd often avoid any constructive criticism and many of the reviews online use very few images. My reviews use lots of high def images, I always include both pros and cons.

feeds.title: OFAH Insider » Hunting
feeds.description: Ontario Federation of Anglers and Hunters is the oldest and largest nonprofit, nongovernment fish and wildlife conservation organization in Canada. With more than 100,000 members, subscribers, and supporters, and 720 member clubs, the OFAH is the VOICE of anglers and hunters.

feeds.title: Canadian Small Game Hunter's Blog
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to meticulously collect and share the stories, techniques, knowledge, and passion for the outdoors and conservation, so that future generations may live and share the same experiences.

feeds.title: North River Outfitting Blog
feeds.description: The North River Outfitting Hunting Blog features stories and photos from our hunting camps, tips, expert interviews, and much more. We provide outstanding Canadian adventures. We specialize in trophy Alberta Whitetail hunts and remote British Columbia combo moose, caribou, and mountain goat hunts.

feeds.title: SCPO » Hunting
feeds.description: Hunting in Saskatchewan, Canada - this is the stuff legendary stories are made of. It's not just a fishing trip, not just a hunting trip. It's an adventure in a world where adventure is getting harder to come by.

feeds.title: Vancouver Hunter
feeds.description: Vancouver Hunter is a blog about hunting, conservation, environmentalism, and organic food sourcing from the point of view of a Vancouverite who came to hunting from a foodie point of view as an adult.

feeds.title: Hunt Fish Manitoba Blog
feeds.description: Get fresh articles and videos on fishing and hunting experiences, destinations, and special events delivered straight to your inbox.Manitoba, Canada, is one of the best places in North America to go hunting and fishing. Black bear, moose, caribou, walleye, catfish, pike; we have it all.

feeds.title: SAIL » Hunting
feeds.description: This section covers articles on hunting. Sail Canada is a Registered Amateur Athletic Association with charitable status, designated by the Government of Canada as a National Sport Organization representing the sport of Sailing.
